theme.common.editThisPage.description: Label on the edit link at the foot of every page. It says 'on GitHub' on purpose: that link is the whole contribution process for this wiki, and a reader should know where they are about to land before clicking. Docusaurus falls back to its own English for every key not listed in this file, so this stays a one-key override rather than the 92-key dump `write-translations` produces.
